# Double Dynamic Dragon research examples (2026-09-29) - reference only, nothing loads this file

# "state" is the exact position (board + candidates) as a Sudoku.Coach string - import it into the app or Sudoku.Coach.
# "puzzle" is the original top1465 puzzle it was reached from; "solved without guessing" = with Double Dynamic added,
# the whole puzzle was solved with no digit placed by brute force.
# All eliminations/placements were checked against the real solution: 0 errors.
